scope: Keep response-model versions explicit when reporting results; comparisons are paired within each bank.

legacy_frozen_bank.teacher: Original two-epoch Qwen-embedding MLP with a transductive training-CTR intercept anchor.
legacy_frozen_bank.note: New Q4 agent runs intentionally reuse the original immutable headline/mean-probability bank; they do not use the clean temporal refit.

clean_temporal_bank.teacher: Fit Nov9–12, select Nov13, refit Nov9–13, calibrate Nov14, evaluate Nov15. Primary Qwen MLP, intercept calibration.
sensitivities: calibration, CTR, gap and temperature transforms

alternate_teacher.teacher: BGE-M3 MLP selected on Nov13, refit Nov9–13, intercept calibrated Nov14.
alternate_teacher.note: Frozen article/user pools and removal masks; different fitted response probabilities. These are sensitivity conditions, not independent real-user datasets.

semantic_validation.note: Automated concept/headline retrieval on 2244 strictly excluded article IDs. No human-annotation claim; one captioner and one independent scoring encoder.
